evidence.note: This report transcribes the completed test-tool output observed in the agent session. No standalone TAP/stdout log was retained. Source and asset hashes were freshly rechecked while writing this report; the tests were not rerun for report creation.

commands.duration_basis: Completed combined test output, rounded to one decimal second in retained session notes.

tests.name: packaged street admission rejects failures before caching and brands only frozen hash-checked assets
street music retries bad bytes and serves the admitted Blob without an unchecked second fetch
street replay canonical roundtrip is bounded and contains controls plus every native outcome
only loader-admitted computations and completed zero-forfeit sessions can export or verify
full reexecution permits only private verified checkpoints and reproduces arbitrary seek order
a valid-looking full outcome edit is rejected after exact reexecution
controls remain bound to the complete outcome and verification cancellation yields no playable result

fixture.controls: Eight ordinary native-driver control streams for the first 700 ticks, then zero controls until the genuine 9000-tick cap; no shortened rules, imported state restoration, or consensus forfeits.
fixture.comparison: Every native graph output, including object broken masks, yaw, lifecycle and fractional finish fields; private replay checkpoints every 30 ticks.

scope_and_adversaries: Canonical bounded JSON roundtrip; rejected whitespace/pretty printing, duplicate keys, alternate number spelling, malformed JSON and over-limit text.

Rejected supplied graph/forfeit fields, extra control columns, non-six-bit or noninteger controls, negative zero, excessive frames, nonterminal or wrong-tick outcomes, unsafe integers and malformed metadata.

Rejected unknown route/computation hash, forged loader-admission objects, unfinished or forfeited exports, changed computation metadata, forged verified-playback token, wrong roster and missing/extra outcome fields.
Full 9000-tick reexecution rejected a structurally valid changed worldBrokenMask and a changed final control with the original outcome.
Arbitrary forward/backward checkpoint seeking matched all captured native outputs; invalid seeks did not change playback; presentation snapshots could not mutate retained output state.
Cancellation after verification progress rejected with AbortError and produced no playable verified result.

Loader rejected unavailable, truncated, oversized and same-length hash-corrupted bytes; failed loads were retryable, concurrent loads shared one request, admitted bundles were deeply frozen, and structural brand forgery failed.
Music corruption was rejected; the cached Blob contained exactly the hash-checked bytes and playback required no second unchecked asset fetch. Fetch redirect policy was checked as error.
limits: These tests exercise the TypeScript interpreter against the pinned native-produced computation bundle. They do not independently qualify Rust parity, an AIR/STARK, or proof-system soundness.
The capped fixture drives for 700 ticks and idles thereafter; it is not an observed human playthrough, a complete eight-human race, or a full-speed 9000-tick performance benchmark.
Asset requests are mocked with actual packaged bytes; network/CDN/provider behavior, browser autoplay, UI lifecycle and camera captures are outside these seven tests.
Dependency and source hashes other than the three explicitly compared post-test pins were recorded at report creation; no historical standalone source snapshot or raw TAP log is asserted.
